relatedSnapshot.title: Customer report: 15 of 36 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error, Reconnect returns "Mailbox not found" and never clears the inbox
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Source

Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

## Bounded conversation context

Customer reports (2026-09-21/22) that several mailboxes have shown an error and have not been sending for over a month; the count has grown from 6 to 15. He has opened several support tickets for the same issue over the past month or two without resolution. A frontline agent reactivated the inboxes on 2026-09-22 and it did not work. He asks for the 15 failing inboxes to be deleted and replaced with working ones and for one month of all 15 being down to be refunded / credited. Three screenshots of the Cold Email Agent email-accounts page were attached. Product area named on the conversation: Email accounts & domains.

## Testable claim

15 of the workspace's 36 pre-warmed sending inboxes are stuck in Error and have sent nothing because the Reconnect path asks the mail provider for a mailbox id it does not resolve, so the provider answers "Mailbox not found" and the inbox never returns to Active, leaving the workspace sending from only 21 inboxes.

## Current evidence

* Production: 33 mail_inbox rows for the workspace, 21 active/connected and 12 status=error, connected=false. The 12 carry three distinct connection errors: 6 "Mailbox OAuth connection threw an exception: Mailbox not found" with the stored provider id echoed in the message, 3 "Disconnected via Company One account_error webhook", 3 "Waiting on zapmail oauth connection".
* Provider: the workspace sub-workspace holds all 36 sending accounts; exactly 15 report a failed status with autofix_failed, timestamped between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-21. Three of those 15 have no local mail_inbox row at all, which is why the local count reads 12 and the customer's count of 15 is the accurate one.
* OAuth session history for the workspace: 16 failed sessions, all "Mailbox OAuth connection threw an exception: Mailbox not found" between 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-22; 50 expired sessions, including repeated "Waiting on zapmail oauth connection" for three inboxes from 2026-08-19/20/21; 30 completed sessions earlier in 2026.
* Sending: the 21 healthy inboxes are still sending; a healthy inbox in the same workspace sent mail on 2026-09-22, the day of the report. An inbox in the failed group last sent on 2026-08-12.
* Name 1: failed process-account-error-reconnect runs in the last week, with the invoke-connect-oauth step failing.

## Suspected code path

* apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-account-error-reconnect.ts (processAccountErrorReconnect) marks the inbox Error and invokes processConnectOAuth with mailboxId = the stored mail_inbox.provider_id.
* apps/web/trpc/routers/outreach/email-accounts.ts (triggerOAuthReconnect) sends mailboxId, orderId and domain as undefined for a customer-initiated Reconnect.
* apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-connect-oauth.ts forwards that id to ColdMailReseller POST /mailboxes/oauth and records "Mailbox OAuth connection threw an exception: Mailbox not found. Context: mailboxId=<id>, email=<address>".
* apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/poll-oauth-session.ts records "Waiting on zapmail oauth connection".

## Blast radius

Counted from production on 2026-09-24: 16,058 inboxes in Error across 1,167 organizations. Of those, 5,762 inboxes / 444 organizations carry the "Mailbox not found" reconnect error, 497 / 87 the account_error webhook state, and 339 / 174 the zapmail oauth class.

relatedSnapshot.title: Refund/credit request: 15 of 36 paid inboxes in Error and not sending, one month of compensation requested
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Source

Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

## Bounded conversation context

Customer reports (2026-09-21/22) that several mailboxes have shown an error and have not been sending for over a month; the count has grown from 6 to 15. He says he has opened several support tickets for the same issue without resolution, that a teammate's fix (reactivating the inboxes) did not work, and that the problem is consuming his time. He asks to have the 15 failing inboxes deleted and replaced with working ones, and to be refunded / credited for one month of all 15 being down. He sent screenshots of the Cold Email Agent email-accounts page.

## Ask

Taxonomy bucket: refund. Requested financial remedy: be compensated for one month of 15 paid inboxes that were in Error and not sending. Alternative remedy the customer may prefer: a credit on the account rather than money back. Open human decision.

## Finding

15 of the workspace's 36 paid sending inboxes are in provider error and silent; the 21 healthy inboxes still send normally. The 15 carry the known ColdMailReseller / Zapmail reconnect defect: the reconnect path cannot resolve a mailbox the provider accepts ("Mailbox not found"), so the inbox never returns to Active. Four of them had already failed by mid-August 2026 and the rest failed from 19 September 2026. The workspace keeps paying the monthly fee for all 36.

## Exposure

Verified from billing records: 36 inbox spend items are active on the account at 8 USD per inbox per month (two active inbox subscriptions, 18 on each, with 36 of 36 inbox entitlements consumed). One month of 15 inboxes is about 120 USD of the account's monthly spend. The monthly plan fee and the healthy inboxes are unaffected. No refund or credit note has previously been issued on this account for these charges.

## Proposed action (proposal, never a promise)

A person on the support/billing side should decide and, if approved, issue a one-month compensation for the 15 affected inboxes (about 120 USD), in the form the customer wants: money back on the card, or an account credit consumed by the next invoice. Separately, a person should arrange the repair or replacement of the 15 inboxes, because replacing them is a paid provisioning action. Do not move money from this investigation.

## Systems of record

* Production workspace state: 33 inbox rows, 21 active/connected and 12 in Error; three further provider accounts exist with no local row. All 36 provider accounts are present in the workspace sub-workspace; 15 report a failed status with autofix_failed.
* Provider state: the 15 accounts are flagged errored at the provider itself, so the durable failure is not a missing provider account.
* Provisioning and entitlements: both inbox subscriptions are active, 36 of 36 inbox entitlements consumed; plan is Legacy Pro plus inbox and domain add-ons. No cancellation or deletion is in flight.
* Money movement: monthly invoices for 36 inboxes have been paid continuously; no refunds or credit notes exist on the account.
* First divergent hop: none. All three systems agree, so the remaining question is human discretion on the remedy.

## Approval trail

none found. No prior approval or promise to compensate, and no prior refund or credit for this outage, appears in the conversation or in the account's billing records.

## Justification checklist

1. The charge matches real invoices and active subscriptions - verified.
2. The disputed amount is quantified from primary billing data - verified (about 120 USD for one month of 15 inboxes at 8 USD each).
3. Plan and add-on state matches the account and production - verified.
4. Product-credit balance and prior-credit history were read from production - verified; no compensation credit is present.
5. A prior approval or promise is quoted, or explicitly absent - verified absent.
6. The ask is one taxonomy bucket - refund, with an account credit named as the customer's possible preference; unresolved.
7. The customer's account was weighed against all systems, with contradictions named - verified; the only contradiction is the customer's count of 15 versus the 12 local Error rows, settled by the provider showing exactly 15 failed accounts.

## Unverified

* The customer's preferred remedy (money back versus account credit) has not been stated in the conversation. It decides the form of the proposal, not its merit.
* Whether he wants the 15 inboxes replaced after all, given that replacement is a new paid provisioning action while his account already bills for 36 inboxes.
* The exact start date of lost sending for each of the 15; local webhook history is empty and provider timestamps are the closest available signal.

## Observations

The product defect behind this ask is confirmed and already tracked as an open engineering master; a customer report for this conversation is raised separately and parented to that master. Do not bury the defect inside this billing record.

relatedSnapshot.title: ColdMailReseller pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error: reconnect sends mailboxId=undefined ("Mailbox not found")
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Overview

Pre-warmed mailboxes provisioned through ColdMailReseller get stuck in an Error state and cannot send, because no reconnect path resolves a mailbox id the provider will accept.

## Problem

When a ColdMailReseller pre-warmed inbox disconnects or needs reconnecting, the account-error reconnect flow fires with `mailboxId: providerId ?? undefined`. These inboxes have `mail_inbox.provider_id = NULL`, so the provider receives `mailboxId=undefined` and the OAuth connect returns "Mailbox not found", leaving the inbox permanently in Error.

## Root cause

`apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-account-error-reconnect.ts` invokes `processConnectOAuth` with `mailboxId: inboxLookup.providerId ?? undefined`. `processConnectOAuth` (`process-connect-oauth.ts`, `connect-mailbox-oauth` step) forwards that `mailboxId` to ColdMailReseller `POST /mailboxes/oauth` via `apps/web/lib/mail/providers/coldmailreseller/client.ts#connectMailboxOAuth`, which rejects it with "Mailbox not found". The inboxes have `mail_inbox.provider_id = NULL`, so the id is never resolved. The reconcile cron (`reconcile-domain-orders-cron.ts`) already looks up the mailbox from ColdMailReseller and passes `mailbox.id` correctly, so the resolution pattern exists.

The failing invariant is one gap across every entry point: no reconnect path resolves the mailbox id from ColdMailReseller before calling the provider. The webhook path forwards the stored `mail_inbox.provider_id`; the customer Reconnect action (`email-accounts.ts`, `triggerOAuthReconnect`) and the admin reconnect (`admin-domain-orders.ts`) both send `mailboxId: undefined`; `processConnectOAuth` never re-resolves. An inbox carrying a named but no-longer-valid id fails identically to one with a NULL id, which is why both counts below sit in this one class.

## Blast radius

5,762 inboxes across 444 organizations carry a `connection_error` containing "Mailbox not found" (query: `SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT organization_id) FROM mail_inbox WHERE connection_error ILIKE '%Mailbox not found%'`, counted 2026-09-24: 5,762 inboxes / 444 organizations, and 7,071 reconnect sessions across 461 organizations failed the same way in the 30 days to 2026-09-24; was 5,763 / 445 on 2026-09-23, 5,660 / 439 on 2026-09-22, 4,364 / 323 on 2026-09-10 and 294 / 39 on 2026-08-28). None of the 5,762 is connected now. 2,391 of them carry the exact `mailboxId=undefined` signature (and all of those have `provider_id IS NULL`); the larger 3,371 carry a named mailbox id and fail the same way. Named-id rows arrive in platform waves (2026-09-04 to 09-06 roughly 2,118 rows across 95+ organizations; 2026-09-19 to 09-20 roughly 1,148 rows across 103 organizations), so the shape is systematic rather than org-specific. A further 2,872 connected pre-warmed inboxes across 228 organizations sit at `provider_id IS NULL` and would fail the same way on their next reconnect.

## Proposed fix

Resolve the provider mailbox id before reconnecting: look up the mailbox from ColdMailReseller (as the reconcile cron already does) instead of passing `provider_id` or `undefined`, and backfill `provider_id` for the affected inboxes so they reconnect successfully.

## Done when

* No reconnect path hands ColdMailReseller an unresolved id: the webhook path stops forwarding the stored `provider_id` unresolved, the customer Reconnect and admin reconnect stop sending `undefined`, and both shapes (NULL `provider_id` and stale named id) reconnect successfully.
* The stuck inboxes are recovered or re-provisioned and resume sending.
* Provider accounts with no local `mail_inbox` row are covered too: Reconnect refuses them outright (`email-accounts.ts#triggerOAuthReconnect` throws PRECONDITION_FAILED "Only managed inboxes can be reconnected.") while their inbox entitlements are still consumed, so the backfill and re-provision step must create or link the missing rows, not only repair a NULL or stale `provider_id`.

## Reports

* ENG-13156
* ENG-13255
* ENG-13511
* ENG-14104
* ENG-14131
* ENG-14197 Customer report: all 15 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error; Reconnect returns Mailbox not found; campaigns cannot send
* ENG-14201 Customer report: 15 of 36 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error; Reconnect returns Mailbox not found and never clears the inbox

Confirmation of whether this is a sync issue or a real cancellation, his inboxes and domains displaying correctly, and a full billing history audit showing how many inboxes and domains he held at each point versus what he was charged, with any overcharge identified and a credit or refund processed.

relatedSnapshot.title: Customer report: 9 of 9 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error for over a week, customer Reconnect still returns "Mailbox not found"
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Source

Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

## Bounded conversation context

Customer wrote on 2026-10-01: "HI guys, my inboxes are still burned. Can I escalate please to get solved asap thanks". The conversation link points at Cold Email Agent > Email Accounts for workspace "<workspace-slug>". Asked twice for a human ("human", "no i need it looked at by a human please") and said the state had persisted "been this way for over a week now". The front-line agent replied 2026-10-02 01:15Z: "Hi Name 14. Let me look into this and I will get back to you". Product area named on the conversation: Email accounts & domains. No financial remedy requested.

* Repeat of the same customer's earlier report (ENG-14130, "Name 14 - inboxes burned", created 2026-09-22), which is already Duplicate of master ENG-13178.

## Testable claim

In workspace "Name 14's Workspace" (organization <uuid>), all 9 platform-managed pre-warmed inboxes sit at status=error / connected=false and cannot be restored by the documented customer action (Cold Email Agent > Email Accounts > Reconnect): the reconnect runs but the provider answers "Mailbox not found", so the inboxes stay in Error and the customer cannot send, which has persisted since at least 2026-09-19.

## Current evidence

* PlanetScale (counted 2026-10-02): all 9 mail_inbox rows in the pinned org are mailbox_type='prewarmed', status='error', connected=false. Five carry connection_error "Mailbox OAuth connection threw an exception: Mailbox not found. Context: mailboxId=<stored provider id>, email=..."; four carry "Disconnected via Company One account_error webhook".
* PlanetScale cea_oauth_sessions: 16 failed sessions for this org, the newest on 2026-10-02 01:19Z, all erroring with "Mailbox not found". Two of the 2026-10-01 sessions carry the exact "mailboxId=undefined" signature (<email>, <email>), which is the in-product Reconnect button's payload.
* Provider (Company One) subworkspace "Name 14's Workspace" (<uuid>): all sending accounts report status -1 (connection error), warmup score 100.
* Code (Acquisity/Acquisity at bd59246c7f993b07fab3c1ed967cedb1ea6af4d8): apps/web/trpc/routers/outreach/email-accounts.ts#triggerOAuthReconnect sends the connect-oauth event with mailboxId: undefined, orderId: undefined, domain: undefined; apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-account-error-reconnect.ts#processAccountErrorReconnect invokes processConnectOAuth with mailboxId: inboxLookup.providerId ?? undefined (line 209); apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-connect-oauth.ts#connect-mailbox-oauth forwards it to ColdMailReseller connectMailboxOAuth, which rejects it.
* Help centre (apps/web/content/docs/cold-email-agent/email-accounts/dfy-warmup-and-reconnect-errors.mdx) documents Reconnect as the fix and tells the customer to escalate to support if Error persists after 48 hours; here that documented step itself fails.

## Relationship

Same root cause as master ENG-13178 (ColdMailReseller pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error: reconnect sends mailboxId=undefined). This report should be attached as a child of ENG-13178, not treated as a fresh root cause.
